scope: Selected primary records; actual reading depths; source records are not independent replications.

sources.title: Passive Reactance Compensation for Shape-Reconfigurable Wireless Power Transfer Surfaces
sources.venue: 2025 IEEE Wireless Power Technology Conference and Expo (WPTCE), accepted-author manuscript
sources.status: published-venue author manuscript; experiments reported by authors
sources.readingDepth: HTML abstract, acceptance statement, Sections I–II and equation (1); experiment claim read in abstract. Full final proceedings version and supplementary data not independently reproduced.
sources.claim: Passive attached reactances can compensate adjacent-resonator detuning in the specified homogeneous relay arrays.
sources.limits: Particular array geometry and circuit assumptions; no energy creation or universal compensation theorem. Conference ranking is not asserted.

sources.title: Dispersive gains enhance wireless power transfer with asymmetric resonance
sources.status: published; published metadata checked against authors institution
sources.readingDepth: Read arXiv:2408.06913v1 abstract, model discussion and experimental Section 2.2; publication date and DOI from CityUHK author-institution record. Final published PDF not read.
sources.claim: A powered dispersive-gain circuit selects asymmetric resonant modes to improve transfer efficiency under the paper model.
sources.limits: Gain-element supplies and whole-system power must be included; the project has not reproduced its hardware or audited all efficiency denominators.

sources.title: Clock Pulling Enables Maximum-Efficiency Wireless Power Transfer
sources.readingDepth: HTML abstract and Section II equations (1), feedback/PLL discussion and Figure 2 caption. HTML rendering also shows a later 2026 date; version history date retained.
sources.claim: Authors propose classical-clock/PLL feedback for selecting a higher-efficiency state in a powered nonlinear WPT system.
sources.limits: Not a source of quantum energy; control power, gain-element power and dynamical stability must be independently audited before system claims.

sources.title: Coupling-aware efficiency modeling of outphasing power amplifiers for wearable wireless power transfer
sources.readingDepth: Publisher HTML abstract, introduction and system-level model through PA assumptions/equations (1)–(4); full transistor-level model and all later results not independently audited.
sources.claim: A system-level efficiency model combines amplifier, combiner and coupling-dependent inductive-link contributions.
sources.limits: Uses ideal source and fixed intrinsic amplifier-efficiency assumptions; analytical and circuit simulation results do not supply a measured apparatus power budget.

sources.title: US649621A: Apparatus for transmission of electrical energy
sources.venue: United States patent US649621A, granted 15 May 1900; inventor Nikola Tesla
sources.status: historical granted patent; no performance validation inferred
sources.readingDepth: Patent text description of transmitter source, receiving load and claims 7–10; metadata and related US645576A family entry. Mirror transcription, not a physical replication.
sources.claim: The proposed transmitting transformer includes an external current source; receiving coils power loads using transferred energy.
sources.limits: The historical high-voltage propagation proposal and its stated atmospheric behavior are not validated by this review. Related family records are not counted as independent inventions.

sources.title: Ultra-broadband low-frequency high-efficiency acoustic energy harvesting with metamaterial-enhanced loudspeakers
sources.readingDepth: Primary PDF retrieved from NSF public-access repository; printed pages 073903-1 to -5 read, including equations 1-21 and experimental method. Supplement not read.
sources.claim: A passive electrodynamic receiver and acoustic matching structure convert incident acoustic power; losses and load affect conversion separately from absorption.
sources.limits: Reported hardware not reproduced. The source's RMS wording alongside factors 1/2 requires an explicit amplitude convention. Its performance is not a prediction for our apparatus.
sources.section: Printed pp. 1-5; equations 7-12, 20; experimental tube schematic Fig. 4

sources.title: Wireless acoustic energy harvesting through an air-water metasurface with dual coupling resonators
sources.readingDepth: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata read. Full text required subscription and was not read.
sources.claim: A metasurface improves acoustic transmission across an impedance-mismatched air-water interface and supports a harvesting demonstration.
sources.limits: Relative transmission enhancement is not absolute conversion efficiency or evidence of additional energy. Detailed power-budget methods not inspected.

sources.title: Hierarchical piezoelectric metasurface for acoustic energy harvesting and noise mitigation
sources.readingDepth: Search-indexed publisher highlights and summary read; direct publisher HTML/PDF returned access errors. Full text not read.
sources.claim: A porous piezoelectric metasurface combines acoustic attenuation with electrical harvesting; reported optima use different frequencies and sound conditions.
sources.limits: Do not combine peak absorption, insulation and output into one operating point or infer conversion from an open-circuit voltage. Hardware claims unreplicated.

sources.title: A Membrane Magnetoelastic Generator for Acoustic Energy Harvesting
sources.readingDepth: PubMed abstract and figure captions 1-4 read. Indexed PMC abstract inspected; direct full PMC access hit a browser check, so full article not read.
sources.claim: A membrane couples acoustic motion through magnetoelasticity and induction, with load sweeps and capacitor charging reported.
sources.limits: A capacitor's energy gain is measurable, but does not alone give total source efficiency. Source acoustic/electrical budget and smartphone demonstration not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Active-Learning-Guided Acoustic Metamaterial Resonators for Low-Frequency Noise Suppression and Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting
sources.readingDepth: Search-indexed publisher results and PubMed abstract/metadata read. Direct publisher page returned 429 and PDF request failed; full text not read.
sources.claim: A Gaussian-process/active-learning and FEM workflow designs resonant cavities that enhance local pressure and reported piezoelectric output.
sources.limits: Geometry optimization does not create energy. Reported normalization, coupling and experimental performance have not been independently reproduced here.

sources.title: Maximal work extraction from finite quantum systems
sources.readingDepth: Primary arXiv v1, cyclic-control definition and Eqs. (1)-(9), eigenvalue ordering and passive-state derivation read; not every later example audited.
sources.claim: Unitary-orbit minimization gives maximum extractable work from a specified nonequilibrium state.
sources.limits: Arbitrary cyclic control and initial-state assumptions matter; preparation and apparatus overhead are not a free resource.

sources.title: Experimental Investigation of Coherent Ergotropy in a Single Spin System
sources.status: published experimental report; not reproduced here
sources.readingDepth: Primary arXiv v1: definitions Eqs. (1)-(2), NV-center preparation/readout paragraphs and supplementary mean-energy measurement description read. Publication status checked at APS.
sources.claim: An NV-center spin experiment distinguishes coherent and incoherent ergotropy for prepared states.
sources.limits: Model-Hamiltonian expectation measurements do not establish whole-laboratory net energy output.

sources.title: Experimental extraction of coherent ergotropy and its energetic cost in a superconducting qubit
sources.status: published experimental report; cost definition scoped
sources.readingDepth: Primary arXiv v2 dated 29 September 2025: state/preparation model, extraction definition, Eq. (4), efficiency definition and conclusions read. APS publication date 1 December 2025 verified.
sources.claim: Prepared-state coherence, decoherence and control-cost choices change extraction performance.
sources.limits: Sigma is time-averaged drive-Hamiltonian norm. Reported efficiency is not a measured wall-plug or cryogenic efficiency.

sources.title: Superextensive electrical power from a quantum battery
sources.status: published 13 March 2026; authors report optical conversion experiment
sources.readingDepth: Publisher abstract and introductory paragraphs read. A subsequent attempt to inspect later sections encountered an inaccessible publisher identity redirect; full methods not audited.
sources.claim: An illuminated microcavity with charge-transport layers exhibits reported superextensive steady-state electrical output scaling.
sources.limits: Incident light supplies energy. Scaling with device size is not efficiency above unity; no complete independent metrology assessment performed here.

sources.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation versus Information Teleportation
sources.readingDepth: Journal metadata and primary arXiv v2 abstract/introduction and finite-dimensional setup overview read; appendix theorem proofs not independently checked.
sources.claim: Entanglement-assisted local operations and classical communication enable constrained work extraction; energy and information teleportation need not optimize together.
sources.limits: This is not a demonstrated macroscopic generator; preparation, measurement, feedback and reset resources must be accounted for.

sources.title: Observation of the dynamical Casimir effect in a superconducting circuit
sources.status: published experimental report; driven photon generation
sources.readingDepth: Primary arXiv v1 abstract, drive/boundary mechanism, pair-frequency condition and Eqs. (1)-(2) read. Publisher page failed. HTML rendering displays 2026 but submission/journal year is 2011.
sources.claim: High-frequency SQUID boundary modulation produces correlated photon pairs in a superconducting transmission line.
sources.limits: The modulation drive supplies energy; no static-vacuum engine or net apparatus-energy claim follows. Specialized cryogenic hardware is required.

sources.title: NIST TN 1297, Appendix A: Law of Propagation of Uncertainty
sources.venue: NIST Technical Note 1297; current official HTML
sources.readingDepth: Full short Appendix A, A.1-A.5; official web page updated 2025-09-11
sources.claim: Measurement models include corrections and relevant uncertainty sources; first-order covariance propagation uses sensitivity coefficients.
sources.limits: Nonlinear propagation needs its approximation checked. This source does not provide this apparatus calibration or a free-energy result.

sources.title: Evaluation of measurement data: Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
sources.readingDepth: Section 5.2, especially 5.2.1-5.2.5, printed pages21-23 / PDF pages32-34; covariance formulas and shared-instrument discussion
sources.claim: Significant correlations between input estimates must be accounted for, including common references and environmental influences.
sources.limits: A covariance model requires empirical or justified Type B information; a coverage factor is not a universal confidence guarantee.

sources.title: AC power wattmeters and voltmeters
sources.readingDepth: Full technical text and scope table on official page; accessed 2026-10-21
sources.claim: Average power is calculated from synchronized voltage-current sample products; transducers and sampling channels require characterization and calibration.
sources.limits: Published calibration scope is instrument/service-specific; no transfer of the listed uncertainty to our proposed apparatus.

sources.title: JCGM 101-compliant uncertainty evaluation using virtual experiments
sources.venue: arXiv:2404.10530v2; metadata says submitted to XXIV IMEKO World Congress2024
sources.readingDepth: Abstract, PDF sections3.1-3.3 including equations/Algorithms1-2, and conclusion; downloaded PDF bytes preserved in private research scratch
sources.claim: Authors derive a virtual-experiment Monte Carlo equivalence for a stated nonlinear class under known Gaussian measurement-variance assumptions.
sources.limits: Not a general license to use arbitrary simulation as measurement evidence; publication acceptance was not independently verified.

sources.title: Power and Energy Measurements Low Frequency Calibrations
sources.venue: NIST calibration-services page; updated2026-05-27 but explicitly no longer maintained
sources.readingDepth: Official technical service conditions, scope, uncertainty descriptions and maintenance warning

sources.limits: Page warns information may be out of date; historical prices, availability and uncertainty are not current purchase guidance or this project specifications.

sources.title: Nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems and their connection to passivity
sources.status: primary mathematical preprint; selected equations inspected
sources.readingDepth: Introduction, definition of passivity and pH-A/pH-B structural assumptions; no full proof audit. v2 dated 16 April 2025.
sources.claim: A nonnegative storage function and conjugate power ports express passivity; skew interconnection and positive-semidefinite dissipation yield an energy inequality.
sources.limits: The cited results have smoothness/model assumptions. A passive numerical realization does not establish the behavior of an uncalibrated device.

sources.title: Nonlinear port-Hamiltonian system identification from input-state-output data (ISO-pHNN)
sources.status: primary computational-method preprint; selected sections inspected
sources.readingDepth: Abstract, introduction and sections 2.1–2.2, including J/R parameterizations and compact-neighborhood Hamiltonian lower-bound caveat. v3 dated 20 August 2026.
sources.claim: The authors identify structured nonlinear dynamics from input-state-output trajectories and report benefits of incorporating prior model structure.
sources.limits: No neural training or author benchmark was reproduced. State access, model class and training-region assumptions matter; this is not a source of energy or an independent experimental conservation test.

sources.title: Identification of Port-Hamiltonian Differential-Algebraic Equations from Input-Output Data
sources.readingDepth: Abstract and introduction/declared contributions. v1 dated 23 January 2026. Full algorithm and proof not audited.
sources.claim: Proposes constrained pH identification from noisy input-output records using an implicit DAE solver, demonstrated by its authors on a DC power network.
sources.limits: Not executed in this project. Reported DC-network performance does not validate a mixed-domain energy apparatus or uniquely identify every hidden parameter.

sources.title: Learnability of Linear Port-Hamiltonian Systems
sources.readingDepth: Official arXiv abstract and version/date metadata only; submitted 28 March 2023.
sources.claim: Describes a structure-preserving identification scheme for SISO linear port-Hamiltonian systems and discusses uniquely identifiable canonical cases.
sources.limits: Full theorem hypotheses and proofs not inspected. Included as a relevant lead, not as a proved identifiability guarantee for the proposed apparatus.

sources.title: Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.TranslationalEMF
sources.readingDepth: Complete short component-description page and revision note; generated 5 June 2020, component initially implemented 2009. Current build-host request timed out; raw versioned-source request failed.
sources.claim: Documents a component that converts electrical energy to translational mechanical energy and connects to the translational mechanics library.
sources.limits: No implementation source inspected and no Modelica simulation run. Historical documentation date must not be presented as a new 2026 research result.

sources.title: DARPA program sets distance record for power beaming
sources.readingDepth: Full short agency release, particularly paragraphs on distance/power and efficiency.
sources.claim: DARPA reports more than 800 W delivered during a 30-second transmission over 8.6 km. The greater-than-20% efficiency statement concerns shorter-distance optical-input to electrical-output measurements.
sources.limits: This release does not report wall-plug efficiency for the 8.6 km run or provide independent raw-data replication. Power comes from an externally powered laser.

sources.title: MARRS Broad Agency Announcement HR001126S0007
sources.readingDepth: Downloaded original PDF; text read printed/PDF pages 1–8; printed/PDF page 4 visually inspected.
sources.claim: The solicitation was posted December 30, 2025, with a March 12, 2026 proposal deadline; it requires falsifiable models and measurements. Page 4 contains a cross-section unit inconsistency: picobarn is paired with 10^-12 cm².
sources.limits: Initial solicitation dates do not establish present award status. The literal unit inconsistency must not enter simulations: 1 pb = 10^-36 cm². This correction does not validate or refute the cited experiments.

sources.title: HR001126S0007 MARRS Frequently Asked Questions, as of February 26, 2026
sources.readingDepth: All five PDF pages opened; focused Q24, Q17, Q4 and Q3.
sources.claim: The FAQ says calorimetry alone is insufficient; energy gain is a long-term vision rather than a program metric. A proposed brute-force route must still address trigger efficiency and a path to gain.
sources.limits: These are proposal requirements, not evidence that any awardee attained gain. Reaction rates, calorimetry, and net system energy remain different quantities.

sources.title: US685957A: Apparatus for the utilization of radiant energy
sources.venue: U.S. patent, reproduced by Google Patents

sources.title: Analysis and Assessment of Gateway Process
sources.venue: Department of the Army; GovInfo archive

sources.limits: The inspected passages provide no calibrated electrical-output, calorimetric or closed-cycle energy measurement. Government custody authenticates this record, not its physical interpretations; no conclusion about every related document is claimed.

sources.title: The International System of Units (SI), 9th edition, V4.01
sources.readingDepth: Table7 printed p138/PDF p28: pico and centi; Table8 printed p140/PDF p30: barn. Selected definitions, not whole brochure.
sources.claim: Pico means 10^-12; centi means 10^-2; one barn is10^-28 square metres. Together these imply one picobarn is10^-36 square centimetres.
sources.limits: This establishes a unit conversion only, not a reaction cross section, achieved energy output or the validity of a government program.

topics.label: Energy boundaries
topics.description: A non-overlapping source, load, loss and storage ledger is required. Model closure does not establish boundary completeness in a device.

topics.label: EM conversion
topics.description: Passive reciprocal transfer at fixed mutual inductance. Active controllers and moving couplers add energy ports.

topics.label: Acoustic conversion
topics.description: Loading changes motion. Receiver conversion, acoustic capture and speaker-system efficiency use different boundaries.

topics.label: Quantum work
topics.description: Ergotropy describes extractable work from a specified prepared state. It is not a source-free apparatus power rating.

topics.label: Measurement errors
topics.description: Phase skew, aliasing, hidden storage and missing inputs produce distinct diagnostic problems. One residual cannot identify them all.

topics.label: Identifiability
topics.description: Within a known model, different internal parameter sets can produce identical electrical spectra. Additional calibrated channels can resolve a declared ambiguity.

topics.label: Programs & patents
topics.description: Government custody, funding, program targets and patent grants have distinct evidential meanings. Demonstrated net energy is a separate claim.

topics.label: Earlier experiments
topics.description: Earlier copper-sphere calculations and acquisition controls inform experimental design. Their source bytes and original limitations are preserved.
